name: Bloodvenom Falls
summary: Toxic water pours over Felwood’s northern cliffs at Bloodvenom Falls. It feeds the Bloodvenom River, carrying demon-spawned rot down the mountains and beyond.

sections.title: A Fountain of Rot
sections.body: Bloodvenom Falls pours over the bluffs in Felwood, a vivid wound in Kalimdor’s ancient forests. Once pristine, the water was warped by demonic magic and the Burning Legion’s remnants during the Third War. The falls feed the Bloodvenom River, which winds through the heart of Felwood. Then the tainted torrent rushes down the mountain slopes and becomes the foul Wildbend River in Darkshore, carrying blight beyond Felwood’s borders.

sections.title: Ecological Poison
sections.body: Runoff from Bloodvenom Falls stains the riverbed and warps all it touches. Twisted treants, sickening beasts, and aggressive slimes breed along the swampy banks around its spray. To druids and wardens trying to contain Felwood’s rot, the falls show how deeply northern Kalimdor’s waters remain sickened at their source.

faq.q: Where does the water from Bloodvenom Falls flow?
faq.answer: The falls feed the Bloodvenom River, which winds across Felwood. It then cascades down the mountains into Darkshore and becomes the corrupted Wildbend River.

During the Third War, the Burning Legion’s demonic magic saturated the region and corrupted Felwood’s wild forests. Fel blight entered the springs and high mountain streams that feed the falls, turning their water into toxic muck.

faq.q: Does the corruption at the falls affect other zones?
faq.answer: Yes. The waters plunge from Felwood down the western mountain crests into Darkshore. There they emerge as the contaminated Wildbend River and carry rot toward the coast.

faq.q: Can the waters of Bloodvenom Falls be purified?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle keeps seeking ways to cleanse Felwood, but the river holds a vast volume of deeply saturated demonic taint. Curing the falls remains a monumental struggle, and the corruption is unresolved.

angles.text: As a druid, you see Bloodvenom Falls as a bitter sight for the Cenarion Circle. Its waters carry Felwood’s vile sickness into the lands below.
As a night elf, you see Bloodvenom Falls feeding the poisoned Wildbend River in Darkshore. Its waters threaten ancestral homes and coastal sanctuaries.
